title: Grade 5 8.07
description: Learning Outcomes for Grade 5: Express simple probability as a fraction | Calculate simple probabilities | Find probability using fractions | Express probability as a fraction | Calculate probability of a single outcome | Calculate probability as a fraction | Express coin toss probability | Calculate probability using fractions | Calculate probability of multiple outcomes | Calculate probabilities of events | Solve probability problems using fractions | Apply probability concepts | Solve real-world probability problems
